complianceFlags.notes: No NOP listing on the OMRI Products List (searched 2026-09-25: 'Eptam'; only an unrelated silicone adjuvant returned). Conventional synthetic thiocarbamate (EPTC) herbicide, Gowan Eptam 7-E EPA 10163-283; label makes no organic-production claim.

notes: Gowan Group 15 thiocarbamate VLCFA inhibitor. Incorporate within 30 min to avoid volatility loss. Strong on yellow nutsedge. chemistryClass is thiocarbamate (#654): the label says Group 15, and the safety kernel treats it as lethal to every crop family except legume forage (alfalfa, birdsfoot trefoil, clovers), the one family the label covers.
